description: Additional GitLab pipeline parsing coverage: minimal image-only document, non-mapping documents rejected as a neutral error, include directive variety (remote/local/project/template/component), spec inputs with defaults and options, expandable variables with descriptions, stages and hidden jobs with after-scripts, and reference-style values preserved verbatim.

input.yaml:
variables:
  FOO: bar
  BAZ:
    value: qux
    expand: false

cases.expected_output:
variable FOO value=bar expand=false
variable BAZ value=qux expand=false

input.yaml:
include:
  - remote: https://example.com/x.yml
  - local: /a/b.yml
  - template: Auto-DevOps.gitlab-ci.yml

test:
  stage: test
  script:
    - make test
  after_script:
    - echo done

cases.expected_output:
job test hidden=false line=1
  script=make test
  after_script=echo done
